Name: Jen's Haunted Farm Cave
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- A Farm Cave with haunted vibes
- The boulder hides a hidden area. It can be removed with a Steel Pickaxe.
- The hidden area contains ore and monsters. Tread carefully.
- Radioactive ore and Cinder Shards can rarely be found in the hidden area.
- Dirt patches in both areas can be tilled and crops can be placed in them. Functions like a greenhouse.
- A small pond in the hidden area allows you to fish up algae, occasionally the Ghost Fish and rarely, the Cave Jelly.
- Two location messages.
[size=4]
[/size][size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Enable Farm Cave Ghost Spawns[/b]: Spawns 0-2 Ghosts in the Farm Cave each day. Any changes will be applied the following in-game day. Only the Host can do this in Multiplayer. (True, False) Defaults False

- [b]Darker Ambient Lighting[/b]: Makes the cave lighting slightly darker. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] or this does nothing. (True, False) Defaults True

- If you don't want ore and/or monsters to spawn in the hidden area, you can open the content.json in the [FTM] Jen's Haunted Farm Cave folder, and set "Large ObjectSpawnEnabled", "OreSpawnEnabled", and/or "MonsterSpawnEnabled" to false. If you want none of these, you can just delete the folder itself.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url].
- Copy Jen's Haunted Farm Cave into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[size=4]Many thanks to those on the SDV Discord for helping me figure out the coding headaches![/size]
